content:
Successful HWPX template automation achieved through XML node consolidation, layout cache removal, and targeted field transformations.
The process merged fragmented '{{placeholder}}' text across multiple 'hp:t' nodes into a single node to ensure injection reliability. Rendering errors were prevented by removing 'lineSegArray' elements using a case-insensitive 'local-name()' check. Specific data formatting was applied to '참석자수' and '만족도' fields, while the 'overall opinion' field was successfully appended with required post-processing text.
